title: Article Archive
notes: Logs one event line per action (for example `page.home` with article, read and unread counts), so *Latest log lines* is the business view.

title: Euro Sapporo Itinerary
notes: No Gatus endpoint. Pods ready reads 0 until the app is deployed to K12; the log panels fill in once it writes logs.

title: Manga Reader
notes: Logs startup, `state.load` and API calls. The weekly fetch cron (Mondays 09:00 Dubai) logs when it runs. The app only logs when it does something, so 0 lines is a quiet day: judge health by the Status tile.

title: PMDR
notes: Gatus checks `/api/health`. Logs are mostly the Next.js startup banner plus any app errors, so a quiet log panel is normal.

title: Rail Console
notes: Logs `http.request` and `k8s.request` events (method, path, status, duration), so *Latest log lines* shows what the console is doing.

title: Sentence Gym
notes: A quiet app: lines appear mostly when the pod restarts (the Next.js startup banner). As of 2026-11-13 some lines carried no message field; fixing that is a code change in the app, not a dashboard change.

title: Vegapunk
notes: Three workloads in one namespace: web (Next.js on Bun), indexer (document indexing worker) and qdrant (vector store; its access log dominates the line count). No Gatus endpoint, so health comes from Pods ready, Restarts and Errors.

title: Wallet Queue
notes: Logs one line per job step: enqueued, started, completed, with `source`, `attempts` and `durationMs`. Smoke-test jobs skip the worker call and finish in a few ms.

title: Whoop MCP Server
notes: Usually silent in VictoriaLogs: its startup logs predate the 2026-11-10 log-stack rebuild and vlagent only tails from its current offset, so 0 lines means no logs were captured, not a broken app. Health comes from the Status tile.

title: Poke Hub
tagline: MCP hub on Vercel, logs shipped to K12 via OTLP
notes: No Gatus endpoint and no pods (Vercel app, not k8s). Logs MCP requests (`mcp.request`), tool calls (`capability.call`, for example `gmail.attachment`) and `external.call`. *Business events* shows completed capability calls only. Log level comes from the OTLP `severity_text`.

title: Friendly Actual Budget
tagline: voice-budget API on Vercel, logs shipped to K12 via OTLP
notes: No Gatus endpoint and no pods (Vercel app, not k8s). Logs the receipt lifecycle: `wallet-ingest-queued`, then `transaction-confirmed` a few seconds later when healthy, plus heartbeats. Receipt lines carry no amount or merchant yet (enriching them needs a code change in friendly-actual-budget). Probe and test activity also emits ingest-wallet, queue-enqueue, accounts, actual-connect and actual-list-accounts lines.
